items.briefing:
Australian small businesses are being targeted by increasingly convincing AI-generated scams, including fake invoices, impersonation emails, and fraudulent requests designed to trick staff into transferring money or sharing information. Separately, the Australian Cyber Security Centre has warned that JetBrains TeamCity servers in Australia are actively being exploited — organisations using this software should apply patches immediately if they haven't already.

If your organisation doesn't use TeamCity, stay alert to suspicious emails or payment requests that seem slightly "off" — AI can now make scam messages look very convincing. When in doubt, verify any unusual financial request by calling the sender directly using a known phone number.

featured.title: AI fuels targeted scams against Australian small firms
featured.summary: Targeted fraud is inflicting bigger losses on small firms as AI helps criminals forge convincing invoices and impersonations in Australia.
